building.name: Rialto Building
building.completed_conflict: The 2008 survey of this district dates the building to 1902; the assessor dates the building on this parcel to 1901. The report gives this building's address as 100 New Montgomery Street in its inventory table and 116 New Montgomery Street in its narrative, and its date as 1901 in the table and 1902 in the narrative.

historical_record.description: Built to plans by Meyer & O'Brien.
Repaired rather than replaced after the 1906 fire gutted it, and back in service by 1910.
Recorded in the city's 2008 survey of the Transit Center District, adopted in 2012, as a contributor to the proposed New Montgomery, Mission & Second Historic District.
